evaluations.evidence: create a new game by entering a name and an optional description
evaluations.rationale: Creating a game with name and optional description is a single feature; the fields are attributes of that game.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL
evaluations.rationale: Inviting estimators through a URL is one access-granting feature.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field
evaluations.rationale: Starting a round by entering an item is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Viewing the session item list is a single feature.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Selecting an item for estimation or re-estimation is one selection feature.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Adding an item to the list is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Editing an item is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Deleting an item is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: Revealing current estimates immediately is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Accepting the average estimate is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: estimate field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Auto-filling the estimate field under one condition is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Entering the agreed estimate is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Re-estimating an earlier story is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Importing stories from a spreadsheet is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Copying and pasting stories from a spreadsheet is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Browsing previous games is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Viewing a transcript is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Exporting a transcript as HTML is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: Exporting a transcript as CSV is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game
evaluations.rationale: Deleting a game is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: create an account for the application by entering my name, email address, a password and a username
evaluations.rationale: Creating an account is one feature; the multiple fields are account attributes, not separate features.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Logging in with account name and password is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Changing account details is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account, so that account information and games are no longer stored
evaluations.rationale: Deleting an account is one feature; the deleted data is an outcome, not a separate feature.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Displaying dates and times in local timezone is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Sending a password reminder by email is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, etc.} or {0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, etc.}
evaluations.rationale: Selecting between estimation scales is one configurable feature; the alternatives are options.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: Inviting up to 15 estimators is one feature with a limit.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Joining a game by entering a name is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Seeing the current item is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Seeing all session items is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Seeing whether an estimator has given an estimate is one presence-status feature.

evaluations.evidence: be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Revealing all estimates simultaneously after everyone has estimated is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: Changing an estimate until revelation is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Viewing prior estimates for the current story is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Viewing who gave what estimates is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Starting a visible countdown timer is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: have the two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Automatically resetting the timer after all estimates are played is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Scrolling back through prior rounds is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Keeping card order consistent is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Changing an estimate until the draw is complete is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: Displaying a thumbnail photo near played cards is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Standards compliance is treated as one feature, with XHTML and CSS as aspects of that compliance.

evaluations.evidence: have a list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Providing a definitions list is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: have created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: Creating database indexes is one performance feature.

evaluations.evidence: function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Supporting the listed browsers is one cross-browser compatibility feature, not separate features.

evaluations.evidence: comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: Accessibility compliance is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: have the application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Fast application response is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Unicode support is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: Having sensible and predictable URLs is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: have nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: Having good error pages is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Storing results in a non-identifiable way is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Viewing usage metrics is one feature.
